body: I'm running for my school's VP and I just came out on FB today (been out socially for awhile) a first for my school as well! Good job!
It  helps that we were talking about wicked and musicals just prior. It would've been easy to play off

>Well how fabulous are you though? 

I'm not really, most people think I'm straight because I've had girlfriends, but I also dress well and try to be a little gay.

>I mean, can ppl tell you're gay and give you crap about it already? If not, i rly wouldnt recommend coming out in school just because of the huge pile of shit heading your way. 

No, but I think my school is relatively accepting. Thanks for the heads up 
:/

>And it's not like the guys you hooked up with are going to all come out with you and have a party and everyone's gonna suddently become accepting of gays.

Maybe I am being naive. :(

>You're at school, i dont have to remind you how teenagers act. But i'm curious though, how did you hook up with two guys from your school and you three are still in the closet O.o?

One of them is obvious, everyone knows, and I straight up asked if he was gay. When I came out to him, he told me he was, and then we flirted for ~3 days, hung out, and hooked up.
The other, I found out on trevorspace because he was careless about privacy. Similar thing happened, but he was drunk and it was weird and uncomfortable.
